arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

# Test bump_major
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print('Original:', v)
print('bump_major():', v.bump_major())

# Test bump_minor
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
print('Original:', v)
print('bump_minor():', v.bump_minor())

# Test bump_patch
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print('Original:', v)
print('bump_patch():', v.bump_patch())

# Test bump_prerelease with existing prerelease
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'rc.1')
print('Original:', v)
print('bump_prerelease():', v.bump_prerelease())

# Test bump_prerelease without prerelease
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print('Original:', v)
print('bump_prerelease():', v.bump_prerelease())

# Test bump_build with existing build
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.5')
print('Original:', v)
print('bump_build():', v.bump_build())

# Test bump_build without build
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print('Original:', v)
print('bump_build():', v.bump_build())
"
